correctness.rationale: Minimal dominating set enumeration was independently implemented from the literal dominate-after-removal predicate on every 2^n vertex subset. For C11 it gives 44 hypotheses and a complete five-query trace histogram over all binom(11,5)=462 supports with maximum 29, excluding VC=5. The source four-query witness and full 32-leaf depth-five tree cover lower bounds; 44<64 excludes depth six. Independently recalculated the full n=3..11 sequence: VC and Ldim agree at (1,2,2,2,3,3,4,4) through C10, then (4,5) at C11. Disjoint-union minimal dominating sets factor, giving VC and Littlestone additivity by product and independent mistake bounds; automorphisms of m disjoint identical cycles are vertex-transitive. Computation proves finite base cases, product proof proves all m.
